data.body: Plan corrected before implementation: the attested v6 plan said prompt_cache_style is derived from the profiles CONCRETE TYPE (isinstance BedrockModelProfile). That is unimplementable in CI. BedrockModelProfile is exported only from pydantic_ai.models.bedrock, which imports botocore at module top; there is no SDK-free pydantic_ai.profiles.bedrock (verified: profiles package has no bedrock submodule); and boto3 appears in pyproject.toml ONLY under the reviewbot extra, so the env running make test lacks it. An isinstance check would break the stdlib-only import rebar.llm contract AND fail CI. Changed to FIELD-PRESENCE detection (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching present => bedrock), which needs no vendor import. AnthropicModelProfile keeps isinstance because pydantic_ai.profiles.anthropic is SDK-free. Bedrock testing is now two-layer: an always-run field-stub assertion plus a boto3-gated test pinning the stubs fields against the REAL BedrockProvider.model_profile, so the stub cannot drift into a fake that passes while real Bedrock breaks. Also added an AC that S2 adds NO new runtime dependency (boto3/[bedrock] is S3 scope). Re-reviewing since this is a material plan change and the close gate requires a current attestation.
